stage: prospective h10 learning, calibration and held evaluation

training.architecture: Fixed train-only PCA, state 61->32->16; base-action/residual 40->16->16; base 32->32->1, anchored advantage 48->32->1. SiLU, no dropout.
training.source_sampling: All unique reached train sources retained. Fourfold sampling for sources with any empirical candidate mean different from a0; includes beneficial and harmful sources. No source bootstrap.
training.stopping: Smallest ensemble relative probability-gain MSE across all eight candidates on the 20 planned inner-held sources; earliest checkpoint wins ties. Refit all 100 planned training sources for selected update count.
training.preprocessing: PCA and projected scaling fitted only on unique inner-train sources, then on all unique training sources for refit. Frozen original visual normalization. Never calibration/validation features.
training.inputs: Current observable visual/proprio/action history and the full ten-step candidate/a0; no privileged states, future states or candidate identifiers.

ranking: Argmax ensemble mean final-success probability over a0 plus eight candidates, a0 wins ties. Winner fixed before any source branch outcome is generated.

calibration.scale: One nonnegative scalar fit through zero to predicted versus observed raw-winner gain, clipped [0,10]; fitted on calibration only.
calibration.acceptance: Keep the fixed raw winner only if scale*(mean_gain-kappa*member_gain_std)>margin; otherwise a0. No reranking after calibration.
calibration.selection: Among the eight registered rules, maximum full-source paired mean gain; ties less harm, then fewer corrections, then first grid index. Disable if no strictly positive calibration rule, or scale=0. If fewer than ten nonzero raw-winner sources, use kappa=0, margin=0 only.
calibration.families: Only this new critic is the primary policy; neither the old critic nor the fixed primitive is selected as a fallback.

evaluation.primary: Frozen calibrated critic versus matched h10 replan on all 50 new validation sources.
evaluation.duplicate_arms: Execute each distinct candidate once per paired replicate; alias identical requested methods to the same sealed trajectory.
evaluation.source_denominator: All 50 planned sources including no alarm/early success. Eight paired suffixes do not count as independent sources.
evaluation.interval: Task-stratified whole-source bootstrap, 10000 draws, seed29015. Report point target and positive lower CI separately.
evaluation.validation_gate: Freeze models and calibrated acceptance before capturing any reserved validation source; do not select settings from its outcomes.

execution.concurrent_preflight: Before consuming any new source, each of 32 workers exactly reproduces a previously sealed h10 preflight branch under concurrent execution; global pass barrier.
execution.earlier_wave: Original eight-worker pilot completed normally before this new wave. No interruption or discarded in-progress work.
execution.outer_lifecycle: All GPU work uses gpu_occupancy_lifecycle.sh run; no idle holders inside a formal wave.
